enemies.name: Desert Bandit
enemies.text: Raiders of the desert roads who prey on villages and travellers. A bandit raises his blade before he strikes — step back or roll behind him while it is up, then punish.

enemies.name: Jackal
enemies.text: A lean desert hunter that circles and lunges with a quick bite. Its wind-up is short, so watch for the crouch and dash out of the lunge.

enemies.name: Giant Scorpion
enemies.text: Armoured from the front: blows to its shell do little, and a stun will not stop its sting. Its wind-up is long — roll behind it and strike its back.

enemies.name: Armoured Scorpion
enemies.text: A scorpion the size of a cart, plated in thick sand-yellow armour. Like its smaller kin it shrugs off blows to the front and will not flinch; its tail rises high before the sting comes down, and the pincers snap shut after it. Roll behind it and work at its back — it takes a long time to fall.

enemies.name: Desert Archer
enemies.text: A bandit with a short bow who keeps his distance and backs away when you close in. A yellow glint on the arrowhead means the arrow is about to fly — block it, parry it back at him as it arrives, roll through it or jump over it, then run him down.

enemies.name: Shield Bandit
enemies.text: A bandit behind a round shield. Blows from the front ring off it — break it with a heavy attack, or roll through him and strike his back. Without the shield he is just a bandit.

enemies.name: Vulture
enemies.text: A carrion bird that circles high over the open desert, out of reach of any blade. When it rises and its beak glints red it is about to dive straight at where you stand — roll under it, then strike while it skims low and climbs back.

enemies.name: Cave Bat
enemies.text: A small bat that hunts in packs in the dark. It flutters at you in a wavy line and bites, then darts away. A white glint means block the bite; one or two blows bring it down.

enemies.name: Cthulhu Fly
enemies.text: A man-sized fly with glowing blue eyes and tentacles for a mouth, one of the alchemist's experiments on the sky's curse. It hovers out of the way of your feet, closes in and slashes with its claws, then pulls back. A white glint means block the claws; it is tougher than it looks.

enemies.name: The Brass Collector
enemies.text: A hulking golem of brass and sandstone with a cage on its back — the Laboratory's catcher of people. Its blows are slow and heavy: roll out of the sweep, jump over the shockwave of its slam, and keep hitting — only a long chain breaks its stance.

enemies.name: The Scorpicore Axe-Warrior
enemies.text: A bald Scorpicore warrior with a huge axe, his face wrapped in a green scarf; he broke into the Mayor Hall on a giant scorpion. Every blow of the axe is heavy: a yellow glint means parry the swing, red means roll — out of the charge, over the slam. Only a long chain of blows breaks his stance.

enemies.name: The Fire Djinn
enemies.text: A burning spirit on a tail of smoke and flame, born in the Laboratory's cells. It claws up close and hurls fire from afar; a glowing mark on the floor means a pillar of fire is coming — step off it. Wounded, it fights faster and throws twice.

enemies.name: The Mercenary [DRAFT]
enemies.text: A drunken manticore-man hired to guard the Laboratory. His small mace strikes quick and twice — block the first blow, parry the second. A red glint on his spiked club means a slam that shakes the floor: roll through it or jump the shockwave. Between attacks he swigs from his flask — that is your moment. [DRAFT]
